interface.longDescription: Local-only HTTP ingress for Codex through the shared agents-comm-bus daemon. Cron jobs, CI pipelines, and local scripts POST JSON payloads to a loopback endpoint; the daemon wakes the target session and injects the payload into its prompt context.
